text:
priya: Heads up — PR #31288 is blocked, windows-smoke consistently failing on shard 7 with a permissions-ish error. Failing test: FileSymlinkPermTest. Looks flaky; repro sometimes locally.
alice: ugh, saw that. Is this the one that started after the fs mock change? @jonathan?
jonathan: yeah I added the fs mock patch. Haven't seen this on linux. Could be a race with cleanup.
priya: here's the failing command output: ```
ERROR: test_FileSymlinkPerm (tests.smoke.test_fs.SyncTests)
AssertionError: expected 0, got 13
OSError: [WinError 5] Access is denied
```
jonathan: hmm windows perms. Could be CI agent antivirus locking the file. dave — any idea about agent cleanup timing?
dave: may be. I'll try a targeted rerun on shard 7 and also run the test locally on my Win VM. Will report back in ~30m.
ci-bot: rerun-request accepted — queued targeted rerun for PR 31288 on pool windows-smoke-shard-7 (job 88712). ETA ~10m.
maya: if it's AV locking, adding a short retry in the test fixture helped before. But prefer to root cause.
priya: thanks dave / ci-bot. pinging reviewers: @alice @jonathan — if rerun looks clean can we get an approve today? I'm trying to make the release cut.
alice: can look after standup. if rerun is green I'll approve. :thumbsup:
dave: local Win VM reproduced with old agent image. AV process (MsMpEng) touched the file right before assertion.
priya: interesting. adding a one-line retry with 50ms backoff in the fixture made it green locally.
jonathan: prefer test change guarded with CI-only retry until infra fix. add a comment + TODO to revert once infra corrected.
priya: updated test -> added retry and TODO. pushed new commit.
ci-bot: build passed on windows-smoke-shard-7 (job 88712) — all green.
alice: saw green, reviewing snapshot diff now.
alice: snapshot diff looks unrelated, small timestamp formatting change in log. approve coming.
priya: thanks! once approved can someone kick merge? I don't want to wait on the queue during the release window.
maya: I can merge and watch. If flake returns I'll open a follow-up to land an infra guard.
priya: :raised_hands: thanks everyone — created issue #452 to track removing the retry once AV is addressed.
jonathan: nice. lesson: windows file tests + AV = 🤦
priya: closing loop — PR merged and release pipeline triggered.
ci-bot: deploy started for release/candidate-2026.1 (job 88900).
